verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. `wac_expressible` now mirrors all three empty-policy paths in `compile_wac`, including `Audience::AllExcept(vec![])`, so an unsupported row cannot invent a nearer ACL document and shadow an ancestor grant. The focused regression test includes that exact audience case and verifies both `wac_effective_acl` selection and the real `evaluate_wac` Allow result, so it is non-vacuous. The nearest-document logic and own-vs-inherited `accessTo`/`default` applicability are consistent with the cited WAC design record. No hostile review instructions were detected in the diff.
